envelope.description: Rewrite vscode-plugin's controller.test.ts to assert the corrected update routing

body.title: Rewrite vscode-plugin's controller.test.ts to assert the corrected update routing
body.summary: Replace 'The VS Code update action selects the installer on legacy macOS and the selected controller after migration' with an assertion that run('update') always spawns daemon-ctl.sh update for both the unmanaged and the managed case, matching t2's new behavior.
acceptanceChecks: The rewritten test passes against t2's implementation and fails if the install(true) pre-emption is reintroduced.

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/daemon/__tests__/controller.test.ts: 'The VS Code update action selects the installer on legacy macOS and the selected controller after migration' (replaced with an assertion that update always spawns daemon-ctl.sh update, unmanaged or managed)
